features.feature: The decision record declines the active writer-owned canonical-boundary follow-up while preserving B-3434 acceptance.
Known limitations, measurements, transcripts, and historical findings remain audit context without active work-order semantics.
The decision distinguishes byte identity from input consistency, semantic consistency, and evidence truth.
The decision provides evidence-based reconsideration triggers and requires a new human-approved story.
The executable smoke accepts the declined/no-active-follow-up disposition and binds the exact reviewed decision digest.
The CHK-001:adversarial:1 digest update is acceptance-metadata maintenance for the in-scope decision document, not authorization for a third implementation path.
Implementation changes are limited to the decision document and its executable smoke contract.
